text:
tara: Heads-up: Solstice Health wants a POC that enforces EU + Canada data residency. They require a sub-processor breakdown, SCC/adequacy note, and an egress multiplier for pricing. Can we assemble a minimal answer set for presales?
bodhi: Quick clarifier: do they insist on no-control-plane-eu-exit, or is control-plane telemetry allowed to route via US?
tara: They said "no customer data leaves region"; control-plane is a separate question. We'll propose hosted pinned first, note control-plane behavior, offer Private for zero-control-plane egress.
rachel: Current in-region data-plane subprocessors: GCP (compute/storage in europe-west1 & ca-central1), Fastly (edge cache only, no persistent logs when configured), Vault (BYOK, optional). I can export a subproc CSV with country and transfer flag.
mike: Egress multipliers rough: ca-central1 +0.20, eu-west1 +0.11. For the SOW use conservative numbers and mark them as estimates. Dedicated adds a monthly reserved fee; if they choose dedicated we can reduce per-token deltas.
tara: Suggested SOW snippet to paste into questionnaire:
```
residency_policy:
  allowed_regions: [europe-west1, ca-central1]
  data_plane: pinned
  control_plane: hosted(us-east1) # Private deployment available to avoid cross-region control-plane flows
  kms: BYOK_supported
  egress_estimate: { ca-central1: 1.20, eu-west1: 1.11 }
```
sre-bot: Ops note: provisioning check passed for pinned dataplane templates in ca/eu. job=88012
bodhi: Security Q "Any transfers outside selected region?" recommended answer: "Data plane is pinned to customer-selected regions. Control-plane orchestration metadata may traverse other regions; Private deployment option removes control-plane egress. See attached attestation and SCC annex."
rachel: I'll upload the CSV and attestation links (SCC pdf, subprocess country list) to the shared folder by EOD.
tara: Customer asked if we can run a 1% EU+CA canary for 24-48h to test latency before full cutover. Is that operationally feasible?
mike: Yes, can route 1% traffic via canary routing policy. Recommend dedicated for consistent SLOs under burst; hosted pinned is fine for a short canary.
tara: Great. Bodhi/Mike/Rachel please drop the precise egress numbers, CSV, and links into the deal room ASAP so I can finalize the security pack. Thanks. :thumbsup:
